kind: Bounded Maia feature on four development archives predating documented pretraining
budget_selection: Cheapest simulated mass-coverage policy satisfying the unchanged <=0.05 maximum bound width and <=0.01 mean oracle midpoint error. The intermediate 97.5% coverage is eligible; the earlier two-option 95/99 fallback is preserved in the simulation directory. No human outcome or regression label chooses this budget.
target_event: (historical win_before - Stockfish19 winning chance after candidate reply) / historical initial_damage >= 0.75, from original mistake-maker perspective
feature_point: Midpoint L+R/2; L=qualified mass in the selected policy prefix, R=unscored mass.
prefix: Sort probabilities descending, UCI ascending as deterministic tie-break; choose smallest prefix whose mass >= coverage. Ignore ALL unselected scores even on cache hits.
leakage: Only known FEN after mistake, original damage/before chance and pre-reply ratings/context. No actual reply, outcome, regret, horizon label or completion flag is parsed by this program. Generate every allowed row, including unrecorded replies.
regression_gate: Fixed LightGBM + midpoint must have positive game-fold MAE improvement with paired 95% lower bound >0 for immediate reply regret; player-purged point gain must be nonnegative. Only then test change_in_damage_10ply. No Optuna.
cautions: The bounds concern numerical integration of a fixed Maia policy under depth-18 candidate scoring. They are not confidence intervals for actual human behavior or bounds on engine finite-search error.
The four archives precede the documented training window; model membership is not independently audited. Maia does not condition on live clocks and some speeds are out of domain.
